reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: 19.1 gives a professional/workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives 90 days for Deliverables (measured from the later of delivery or acceptance) and continuous conformity for Hosted Services through the subscription term, which meets or exceeds the preferred duration standard.

Remedy stack in 19.4 (re-perform/repair/replace, then termination and refund of Fees paid) matches the model remedy language, and it is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.

19.3 adds malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties, and 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties while expressly preserving express warranties, service levels, indemnities and remedies — no 'AS IS' and no disclaimer swallowing the express warranty, so walk-away territory is not implicated.
The failed deterministic check is a phrasing artifact only: the period is written out as 'ninety days' rather than numerically, so the regex miss is not substantive.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed; the redline output is identical to the original paragraphs, which is correct here.
